hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Charges a 1.2% fee on all swaps: buy-side (ETH->token) fees accumulate in a native burn pot and are periodically used to buyback and burn tokens; sell-side (token->ETH) fees are taken and burned directly. Blocks all liquidity additions after the first and reverts exact-output swaps. An afterSwap allowlist (hasValue) can gate sells; the restriction is enabled permissionlessly by anyone via burner(), while allowlist membership is owner-controlled.
